sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A trailing Tradescantia with banded foliage; NC State describes the species as fast-growing and readily propagated from stem cuttings.

sections.title: Identification
sections.content: Trailing stems and opposite leaves with green/silver striping and purple undersides; small pink-purple flowers may appear.
